title: Late Charge Schedule Extract for Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Unit Notices: Projected Late Fees
content:
**Schedule rule.** On a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, where rent of the in-flight draft's due date is left unpaid, it stays unpaid past the grace period and past the second-late-fee day before the noticed draft runs, so the unit notice amount adds projected late fees of:

- **nothing**, where no rent of the in-flight draft's due date is left unpaid;
- otherwise **a late fee plus the second late fee**, the late fee being:
  - the **maximum late fee**, when the late-fee percentage of rent times the rent in force on the in-flight draft's due date, rounded to the cent, is above the maximum late fee;
  - **that percentage amount**, when it is above the flat late fee (and not above the maximum);
  - the **flat late fee**, otherwise.

**Figures by unit class of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.**

| Unit class | Flat late fee | Maximum late fee | Late-fee percentage of rent | Second late fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $20.00 | $45.00 | 20% | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $20.00 | $45.00 | 20% | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | $55.00 | 15% | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | $60.00 | 15% | $20.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30.00 | $75.00 | 10% | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30.00 | $75.00 | 10% | $25.00 |

### Ladder on both sides of each threshold (hypothetical rents in force, Bluegate Drive-Up Standard: flat $20.00, maximum $45.00, 20%, second $15.00)

| Rent in force on the in-flight draft's due date | Percentage amount | Late fee | Projected late fees |
|---|---|---|---|
| $90.00 | $18.00 — not above $20.00 | $20.00 (flat) | $35.00 |
| $100.00 | $20.00 — equal, not above $20.00 | $20.00 (flat) | $35.00 |
| $100.05 | $20.01 — above $20.00, not above $45.00 | $20.01 | $35.01 |
| $225.00 | $45.00 — not above $45.00 | $45.00 | $60.00 |
| $250.00 | $50.00 — above $45.00 | $45.00 (maximum) | $60.00 |
| any, with no rent of that due date left unpaid | — | — | nothing |

The percentage is applied to the rent in force on the in-flight draft's due date as it stands, before any military discount.
